intent: Welcome: the vault is optional and only for files that must not be committed
notes: "What Gator can do" no longer presents Gator Vault as the standard
staging path for drafts. The Architect clarified that the vault is
optional, and only for files that must never be committed: CSV extracts,
personal or other sensitive data, plans that are not ready to share,
diagrams that are not ready for publication, and large files. Code,
charters and documentation are drafted in the repository and reviewed
through Git as usual. This matches the `.gator/vault/` ignore rule that
Gatorize installs ("sensitive material and large files").
